sn_aia_tool.description: This tool can be used to retrieve a specific upgrade history record based on the name specified by the user in the query which is taken as the input "upgradeName"
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"upgradeName","description":"This is the name of the upgraded plugin to be retrieved from the Upgrade History record.","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Retrieve Upgrade History Record
